Windows Python-only distribution

This package contains no project C++, Cython, Numba, compiled extension modules, native wrappers, or native build scripts.
All physical ODE models use scipy.integrate.solve_ivp. Auto selects RK45 for standard models and Radau for designated stiff models.
HONU, MLP, direct multi-horizon prediction, MPC optimization, and MRAC adaptation use their NumPy/SciPy Python implementations.
